entities.summary: Janaab Pakal, a notable figure in the history of Mexico, associated with Classic Maya in Mexican Territory (431–799). Preceded by Palenque and the Dynasty of Pakal and Pakal Accession 615. Their legacy influenced Calakmul — Snake Dynasty Superpower and Kaan.
